Full sources are first located in repository records dated 8 July 2018, 23 December 2022 and 19 February 2023; these are not established first publication days. Descending moves preserve histories and exact source identity. Current gameplay <code>4_93</code> follows image 4; existing <code>4_93e1</code> publication identity follows the 2018 image without an implementation claim.
